description:
We are looking for .Net Developer in Atlanta, GA for 6+ months contract position.  
 
 Please refer someone else if you are not available at this time or you are not right match for this job opportunity. We have great Referral Bonus up to $2500!!! Please don't miss to refer someone who are looking for projects. 
 
 
 Job details mentioned bellows: 
 Job Title: .Net Developer 
 Location: Atlanta, GA 
 Duration: 6+ months 
 Client: Direct Client 
 Rate: $40 - $45/hr 
 Note: Need US Citizen only 
 
 Seeking a mid ‐ level .Net Developer who is able to independently solve analytical problems with innovative approaches and solutions. The qualified individual will be a team player that has experience developing applications through the entire SDLC utilizing Visual Basic .NET, ASP.NET, and C#. Familiarity with various technologies is essential as is attention to detail and thoroughness. 
 As a part of the development team, the developer will be responsible for supporting and adding new functionality and enhancements to the existing internal applications while also aiding Senior level developers in new application development. 
 
 Required experience: 
 · Four years of experience developing with Microsoft ASP.Net 3.5 and up 
 · Experience with C#, HTML, CSS3, JavaScript, WCF/Restful/Soap Web services 
 · Four years of experience in class libraries design and general application architecture. 
 · Four years of experience with SQL Server 2008 or later, ODP.NET and writing stored procedures / functions. 
 · Four years of experience with AJAX tools 
 · In depth knowledge of Web Application .NET programming methodology Experience with Entity Framework 
 · Experience with Client UI tools like JQuery, Bootstrap 
 · Working knowledge of IIS 7.0 or later versions. 
 · Experience developing multi-tier web applications 
 · Understanding of common web protocols (e.g., TCP / IP, HTTP, HTTPS etc.) 
 · Familiarity with using version control systems 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
